text: 央行：为更好匹配银行体系短期流动性需求，中国人民银行将在8月14日、8月17日至8月19日开展隔夜逆回购操作，采用固定利率、数量招标，每日操作量不超过6000亿元
text_en: Central bank: To better match banks' short-term liquidity needs, the People's Bank of China will conduct overnight reverse repo operations on August 14 and August 17-19, using fixed rates and quantity tenders, with daily operations not exceeding 600 billion yuan
